question: How much did Vexev raise in its latest funding round?

hits.title: Vexev raises $6M to accelerate U.S. Commercialization of autonomous vascular imaging platform.
hits.snippet: medical robotics company Vexev today announced it has raised $6 million in new funding to accelerate the path to FDA 510(k) clearance and U.S. commercialization of VxWave, its robotic tomographic ultrasound platform, designed to improve access to standardized vascular imaging.

hits.title: UNSW medical robotics spinout raises $8.6m for US ambitions.
hits.snippet: The round for UNSW spinout Vexev was backed by existing investors Blackbird, Neotribe, Startmate and Horizon, with TreeArc Investment Group, TEN13, Bioshore and Alumni Ventures also joining the cap table.

hits.title: Vascular imaging medtech raises $8.5 million
hits.snippet: Sydney medtech startup Vexev has raised $8.5 million to ramp up the global expansion of its 3D medical imaging device.

ar.note: Rank 1 states Vexev raised $6 million; ranks 2-3 cite different amounts (A$8.6m, $8.5m) not recoverable as $6M.
